preconditions.description: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The number of vertexes in the graph is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: graph G is simple and undirected
preconditions.description: The graph has no self-loops and is undirected, meaning Gij = Gji for all i, j.

preconditions.expression: there is at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2
preconditions.description: The graph is connected, ensuring there is at least one path from vertex 1 to vertex 2.

postconditions.expression: output n and the adjacency matrix G
postconditions.description: The output must include the number of vertexes n and an adjacency matrix G representing the graph. Each element of G is either 'Y' or 'N', indicating the presence or absence of an edge between two vertexes.

postconditions.expression: exactly k shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2
postconditions.description: The graph must be constructed such that there are exactly k shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
